Source: [`R/classes.R`](https://codeberg.org/usrbinr/ti/src/branch/main/R/classes.R)
:::

<p><code>datum</code> wraps the user's table together with the metadata every
time-intelligence function needs: which column holds the date, what calendar
the dates should be interpreted against, and how the table is grouped. Most
of its properties are read-only and computed on access from <code>data</code> and
<code>date_vec</code>, so they always reflect the current table.
</p>

## Usage

```r
datum(
  data = NULL,
  calendar_type = "standard",
  fiscal_year_start = 1,
  date_vec = NULL
)
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-data"><code>data</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-data"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A <code>data.frame</code> or <code>tbl_dbi</code>. Converted to a lazy table with
<code><a href="make_db_tbl.qmd">make_db_tbl()</a></code> on assignment.</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-calendar-type"><code>calendar_type</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-calendar-type"></a></dt>
<dd><p>One of <code>"standard"</code>, <code>"445"</code>, <code>"454"</code> or <code>"544"</code>.
Lower-cased on assignment.</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-fiscal-year-start"><code>fiscal_year_start</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-fiscal-year-start"></a></dt>
<dd><p>Integer between 1 and 12 giving the month the fiscal
year starts in.</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-date-vec"><code>date_vec</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-date-vec"></a></dt>
<dd><p>The name of the date column, as a string.</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>A <code>datum</code> S7 object.
</p>

## Additional properties

<dl>
<dt><code>@class_name</code></dt>
<dd>
<p><code>"dbi"</code> if <code>data</code> is a database table, otherwise <code>"tbl"</code>.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@date_quo</code></dt>
<dd>
<p><code>date_vec</code> parsed to a symbol for tidy evaluation.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@min_date</code></dt>
<dd>
<p>The earliest value of the date column.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@max_date</code></dt>
<dd>
<p>The latest value of the date column.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@date_range</code></dt>
<dd>
<p>Number of days between <code>min_date</code> and <code>max_date</code>.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@date_count</code></dt>
<dd>
<p>Number of distinct dates present in the date column.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@date_missing</code></dt>
<dd>
<p><code>date_range</code> minus <code>date_count</code>, i.e. gaps in the calendar.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@group_indicator</code></dt>
<dd>
<p><code>TRUE</code> if <code>data</code> carries grouping variables.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@group_quo</code></dt>
<dd>
<p>The grouping variables as a list of symbols.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@group_vec</code></dt>
<dd>
<p>The grouping variables as a character vector.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code>@group_count</code></dt>
<dd>
<p>Number of grouping variables.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
